mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sa_refresh_token (user_id, session_id, token_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, session_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at, create_time, last_used_at FROM sa_refresh_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash}
mapper.update: UPDATE sa_refresh_token SET revoked_at = COALESCE(revoked_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND session_id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE sa_refresh_token SET revoked_at = COALESCE(revoked_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE sa_refresh_token SET last_used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
